instruction: I am currently using an Ubuntu system. Could you help me set the default web browser to Firefox?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Firefox as the default web browser in Ubuntu. Similar to the original VLC video player task, this uses xdg-mime to query the default application for web-related MIME types (text/html, x-scheme-handler/http, etc.). The evaluator checks if the default browser contains 'firefox.desktop'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly queries web-related MIME types (text/html, x-scheme-handler/http, x-scheme-handler/https, etc.) using xdg-mime to determine default web browser
Getter returns the most common default app across all queried MIME types, which is the correct approach for Linux systems
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - uses rules.get('include', []) to directly access the rules dictionary (not rules.get('rules', {}))
Data flow is correct: getter returns 'firefox.desktop' string, metric checks if 'firefox.desktop' is in the result string using substring matching
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (Firefox as default web browser)
Edge cases handled: getter returns 'unknown' if no defaults found, metric handles None results and empty include/exclude lists
Evaluator will correctly verify the task at runtime
